en-us.com_instrument_practice_outdoor: Practice an Instrument on the Bench
en-us.com_instrument_practice_outdoor_begin: $doer.firstname$ sits down on the bench, tunes the instrument, and tries a few notes.
en-us.com_instrument_practice_outdoor_ongoing: $doer.firstname$ works through a passage that still needs practice, over and over.
en-us.com_instrument_practice_outdoor_after: $doer.firstname$ finishes the passage and loosens up their fingers.
